name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.multiple.SpeechVoiceMultiplePrimarySingleActivity
description: For some single-task, experience, or return-visit offers, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows this page with advertiser instructions and reward progress, then prompts the user to continue the task.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the SDK's alternate task and reward flow from completing, so its ad reward will no longer be granted.
